text:
```yaml
name: Trigger All Workflows

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  trigger-all:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: {}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Trigger service workflows
        id: trigger-service-workflows
        uses: benc-uk/workflow-dispatch@v1
        with:
          workflow: 'bioservices/service-template.yml'
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          inputs: '{"service": "all"}'  # Adjust inputs as needed
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}
          repo: ${{ github.repository }}
          wait-for-completion: true
          wait-timeout-seconds: 3600
          wait-interval-seconds: 60
```
